description: Defines an immutable singleton class representing a JSON null object, implementing JsonObject and JsonNull interfaces with methods for handling JSON object behavior and null semantics.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonObjectNull
classes.description: Singleton class representing a JSON null object, immutable, implementing JsonObject and JsonNull interfaces.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ImmutableJsonObjectNull.

methods.name: isNull
methods.description: Indicates that this object represents a null value.

methods.name: isObject
methods.description: Indicates that this object is considered a JSON object.

methods.name: asObject
methods.description: Returns this object as a JsonObject.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Methods for setting values for keys, all return the singleton instance without modification.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the object, always returns false.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value or sub-object at a given pointer or field definition, always returns this.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value for a key, returns Optional.empty().

methods.name: getValueOrThrow
methods.description: Throws exception if a value is missing.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Returns an empty list of keys.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Returns an empty Optional for any key.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an empty iterator over fields.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns an empty stream of fields.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Indicates the object is empty, always true.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of JSON null literal.
